intro: Supporting people with their medicines is a serious responsibility, so know your role, its limits, and when to stop and ask.
points: This course is awareness only; you may only administer medicines after employer training and a signed competency assessment, reviewed yearly.
Run the medication "rights" every time, and if any right cannot be confirmed, do not give the medicine until it is checked.
An adult with capacity may refuse any medicine for any reason; respect and record it, and never disguise doses covertly.
Time-critical medicines like Parkinson's, insulin and epilepsy drugs must be given on time; if running late, ring the office immediately.
Record on the MAR chart only after a dose is taken; a gap means the medicine is assumed not given.
Report every error and near miss honestly under the no-blame culture; poor medicines practice can be neglect under the Care Act 2014.
